nodes.label: NOTE: in-memory state hanya valid per-instance Node.js. Jika di-deploy
nodes.norm_label: note: in-memory state hanya valid per-instance node.js. jika di-deploy

nodes.label: Webhook /api/payment-links/webhook
nodes.rationale: Wajib verifySignature, validasi nominal == grand_total, idempoten; tidak percaya status redirect browser.

nodes.label: Worker /api/cron/process-paid-invoices
nodes.rationale: Opsi B dipilih: webhook hanya set PAID_GATEWAY, worker memproses provider agar tahan timeout, retry dan observability lebih baik.

nodes.label: digitalReceiptUrl (field formatter struk)
nodes.rationale: ESC/P mencetak URL validasi karena dot matrix tidak membuat QR bitmap; browser print menampilkan QR image.

nodes.label: Payment Link dari hasil inquiry kasir (/pembayaran)
nodes.norm_label: payment link dari hasil inquiry kasir (/pembayaran)

nodes.label: Refund/Dispute FAILED_PROVIDER (/payment-links/disputes)
nodes.rationale: Workflow manual; refund otomatis ke gateway belum diterapkan.

nodes.label: Self-Service Cek Tagihan (/cek-tagihan)
nodes.rationale: Agar aplikasi dipakai pelanggan langsung, bukan hanya kasir internal.

nodes.label: SELF_SERVICE_LOKET_CODE
nodes.rationale: Menentukan loket default untuk transaksi self-service (admin PDAM, tier PLN, batas tagihan); di production sebaiknya loket khusus ONLINE; fallback ke loket aktif pertama.

nodes.label: Layanan self-service didukung (PDAM, PLN, BPJS, Telkom, Pulsa, Paket Data)
nodes.norm_label: layanan self-service didukung (pdam, pln, bpjs, telkom, pulsa, paket data)

nodes.label: APP_PUBLIC_URL
nodes.rationale: Dipakai untuk callback Midtrans, URL invoice dan struk; fallback NEXTAUTH_URL; jangan ubah NEXTAUTH_URL sembarangan karena cookie auth.

nodes.label: CRON_SECRET / X-Cron-Secret
nodes.rationale: Melindungi endpoint worker; development lokal tanpa secret boleh dari localhost.

nodes.label: Pengembangan lanjutan (cart→link, QR, WhatsApp API, refund, rekonsiliasi, dashboard)
nodes.norm_label: pengembangan lanjutan (cart→link, qr, whatsapp api, refund, rekonsiliasi, dashboard)

nodes.label: Item Tagihan JSON (UI MVP)
nodes.rationale: JSON manual agar fleksibel untuk semua produk; diusulkan diganti integrasi cart multipay.

nodes.label: Struk Digital
nodes.rationale: Mencegah struk palsu: receipt token + halaman validasi resmi + QR.

nodes.label: Status FAILED_PROVIDER
nodes.rationale: Gateway sukses tetapi provider gagal; masuk antrean refund/dispute/manual.

nodes.label: Halaman /invoice/[token]/finish|unfinish|error
nodes.rationale: Hanya UX; status final dari webhook/status check server.

nodes.label: Status PAID_GATEWAY
nodes.rationale: Dana gateway diterima tetapi tagihan provider belum tentu terbayar.

nodes.label: Tabel payment_invoice_items
nodes.rationale: Menyimpan inquiry_snapshot agar nominal tidak berubah diam-diam (invoice immutable).

nodes.label: Payment Link / Invoice Online
nodes.rationale: Lapisan invoice publik di atas multipay existing, bukan tabel transaksi terpisah, agar laporan, reprint, settlement tetap memakai multi_payment_requests/items dan logic provider tidak terduplikasi.

nodes.label: SnapRequest.callbacks (finish/unfinish/error)
nodes.rationale: createSnapTransaction semula callback ke /topup/finish; dibuat fleksibel untuk /invoice/[token]/*.

nodes.label: Rate limit in-memory berbasis IP
nodes.rationale: Hanya berlaku per instance; multi-instance sebaiknya Redis.

nodes.label: Lapisan idempotensi (idempotency_key, gateway_order_id, multi_payment_requests.idempotency_key, guard PAID_GATEWAY & multi_payment_code IS NULL)
nodes.norm_label: lapisan idempotensi (idempotency_key, gateway_order_id, multi_payment_requests.idempotency_key, guard paid_gateway & multi_payment_code is null)

nodes.label: Opsi A: webhook langsung memanggil orchestrator
nodes.norm_label: opsi a: webhook langsung memanggil orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Lebih cepat, tetapi webhook bisa timeout bila provider lambat; ditolak untuk production.

nodes.label: Opsi B: webhook enqueue, worker memproses
nodes.norm_label: opsi b: webhook enqueue, worker memproses
nodes.rationale: Direkomendasikan untuk production; cocok dengan pola system_jobs.

nodes.label: Public token / receipt token (randomBytes(32) hex)
nodes.rationale: Jangan pakai ID incremental di URL publik agar link tidak bisa ditebak.

nodes.label: Centralized RBAC (rbac.ts + middleware)
nodes.rationale: Middleware must live in src/ and run on edge runtime without Node modules

nodes.label: API RBAC Default Deny
nodes.rationale: Middleware skipped /api/*; unregistered endpoints fail-open

nodes.label: Offline Fallback Page (offline.html)
nodes.rationale: Shown when PWA has no connection; payments can only be processed online, so it offers a reload button rather than offline functionality.

nodes.label: PDAM and PLN bill status cards (LUNAS)
nodes.norm_label: pdam and pln bill status cards (lunas)

nodes.label: vscode_askQuestions Confirmation Loop
nodes.rationale: Ask user to confirm after each task and loop until accepted, to save tokens and avoid unrequested work

nodes.label: Document with checkmark icon (likely iOS home-screen app icon)
nodes.norm_label: document with checkmark icon (likely ios home-screen app icon)

nodes.label: Document with checkmark icon (blue rounded square)
nodes.norm_label: document with checkmark icon (blue rounded square)

nodes.label: Zero External Dependencies (Node built-ins only)
nodes.rationale: Uses only http, child_process, fs so no npm install is needed on cashier PCs.

nodes.label: Decorative Line Dropping When Overflowing
nodes.rationale: When content exceeds pageLines - topMargin, formatter drops decorative lines (reprint note, subtitle, separators, scan instructions) so the receipt fits one piece; billing data, amounts, token and URL are never dropped.

nodes.label: 1 Tagihan = 1 Lembar (pageLines continuous form)
nodes.rationale: 9.5x11/3 perforated paper requires pageLines 22; 66 would make each bill consume 3 pieces. Bridge sends ESC 2, ESC C n, ESC O per job; Windows print processor must be WinPrint+RAW so no extra form feed is added.

nodes.label: RAW ASCII + CRLF + Form Feed Output (no ESC bold)
nodes.norm_label: raw ascii + crlf + form feed output (no esc bold)
nodes.rationale: The Epson ESC/P 9pin V4 Class Driver on USB001 holds certain jobs sent via WinSpooler RAW or containing unsafe control/non-ASCII characters, so the LX-310 uses copy mode to share \\localhost\EPSONLX with plain RAW ASCII.

nodes.label: Harden or Disable DB Manage
nodes.rationale: Free SQL endpoint equals remote DB admin

nodes.label: Balance Hold Model
nodes.rationale: Debit loket balance before calling provider; keep hold while pending; release on FAILED, adjust on SUCCESS

nodes.label: buildReceiptDataFromMultiPaymentCode / buildReceiptDataFromTransactionCode / sanitizePublicReceiptData
nodes.rationale: Refactor ringan agar reprint internal dan struk digital publik tidak menduplikasi parsing metadata.

nodes.label: Payment Link Stuck at PROCESSING_PROVIDER
nodes.rationale: Gateway paid but provider orchestration failed; cron only picks PAID_GATEWAY

nodes.label: Webhook Retry and Dead Letter Queue
nodes.norm_label: webhook retry and dead letter queue

nodes.label: Settlement Daily Cron with system_jobs Lock
nodes.norm_label: settlement daily cron with system_jobs lock

nodes.label: Idempotency with request_hash
nodes.rationale: Same key with different payload returns 409

nodes.label: Secrets Out of Repo / Rotate Credentials
nodes.norm_label: secrets out of repo / rotate credentials
nodes.rationale: Leaked credentials must be treated as compromised

nodes.label: Known Gaps (manual SUCCESS tx, advice GL/commission, Node guard)
nodes.norm_label: known gaps (manual success tx, advice gl/commission, node guard)

nodes.label: NEXT_PHASE Build-Time Env Guard
nodes.rationale: Module-level code runs at build; avoid throwing on env vars

nodes.label: Commission / Profit Sharing
nodes.rationale: Best-effort: failure does not cancel payment

nodes.label: Dual-Mode API Auth (cookie + mobile Bearer JWT)
nodes.norm_label: dual-mode api auth (cookie + mobile bearer jwt)

nodes.label: Multi-Payment Bayar Semua via SSE
nodes.rationale: Group by provider+customer, parallel per customer, sequential per provider

nodes.label: PDAM Payment Module (retry, advice, circuit breaker)
nodes.norm_label: pdam payment module (retry, advice, circuit breaker)

nodes.label: Tech Stack (Next.js, mysql2, NextAuth, Midtrans, OTel)
nodes.norm_label: tech stack (next.js, mysql2, nextauth, midtrans, otel)

nodes.label: Best-Effort GL Posting
nodes.rationale: GL failure must not cancel successful payment

nodes.label: Akuntansi online: Piutang Payment Gateway (1202) & Beban MDR (5102)
nodes.norm_label: akuntansi online: piutang payment gateway (1202) & beban mdr (5102)
nodes.rationale: Uang online masuk ke gateway receivable, bukan kas loket; tahap awal pakai posting minimal postPaymentSuccess, tabel sudah menyimpan gateway_fee/payment_method/payload untuk rekonsiliasi lanjut.

nodes.label: Loket Balance Ledger
nodes.rationale: Every balance mutation recorded in loket_balance_ledger via saldo-mutations

nodes.label: PDAM / Lunasin Mock Scenarios
nodes.rationale: Customer ID prefixes select scenarios (1111 success, 4444 timeout->advice, 7777 error, etc.)

nodes.label: Stale Pending Transactions (/pending-transaksi)
nodes.rationale: Cancel only if provider provably not contacted (assessProviderContact)

nodes.label: Transaction Void (/pembatalan)
nodes.rationale: Produces refund ledger, REVERSAL journal, commission VOID

nodes.label: Auto Print After Payment with Hidden Iframe Fallback
nodes.norm_label: auto print after payment with hidden iframe fallback
nodes.rationale: window.open is blocked without user click

nodes.label: Dual Receipt Formatters (print-bridge + browser)
nodes.rationale: Both formatters must change together; 1 bill = 1 sheet = 22 lines

nodes.label: Maker-Checker Approval
nodes.rationale: FAILED/refund review decisions and voids need a second user to approve

nodes.label: Do Not Run Second next dev
nodes.norm_label: do not run second next dev
nodes.rationale: Second dev server in same folder corrupts .next and breaks login sessions

nodes.label: Node Minimum 22.23.4 (CVE-2026-111497)
nodes.rationale: Patch for Node2Shell vulnerability; Dockerfile pins node:22.23.4-alpine, nixpacks does not pin patch

nodes.label: Transactional Atomic Saldo Mutation
nodes.rationale: Prevent race conditions and negative balances; immutable ledger

nodes.label: system_jobs Job Lock
nodes.rationale: Prevents double-run when cron fires twice

nodes.label: Daily PDAM Reconciliation Excel Email Job
nodes.norm_label: daily pdam reconciliation excel email job

nodes.label: SMTP Configuration (.env)
nodes.rationale: Gmail requires App Password

nodes.label: Trust Certificate in Browser (once per browser)
nodes.norm_label: trust certificate in browser (once per browser)

nodes.label: Print Modes (ps | copy | direct)
nodes.rationale: ps uses PowerShell + WinSpooler API for modern USB printers; copy uses 'copy /b file LPT3:' or a shared printer path for printers mapped via net use.

nodes.label: Bridge Update Procedure (stop, git pull, restart)
nodes.norm_label: bridge update procedure (stop, git pull, restart)

nodes.label: HTTPS Print Bridge via Self-Signed Certificate
nodes.norm_label: https print bridge via self-signed certificate
nodes.rationale: Browsers block HTTPS pages from calling HTTP endpoints (mixed content), including local IPs; Firefox/Safari block even http://localhost. Running the bridge on https://localhost:6789 with a self-signed cert is the only reliable option when the app is hosted over HTTPS.

nodes.label: Advice Attempt Limit (ADVICE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
nodes.rationale: Default 3; after exhaustion -> PENDING_REVIEW

nodes.label: Auto-Resolve Pending Worker
nodes.rationale: Phase 1: PENDING>15min -> PENDING_ADVICE; Phase 2: >=6 attempts or >60min -> FAILED AUTO_REVERSED

nodes.label: Immutable Hash-Chained Audit Log
nodes.rationale: auditLog never throws; best-effort

nodes.label: Unknown Provider Outcome Is Not Failure
nodes.norm_label: unknown provider outcome is not failure
nodes.rationale: Timeouts/5xx/broken responses become PENDING_ADVICE with hold kept to avoid double payment or wrongful refund

nodes.label: Safer Provider Retry and Advice
nodes.rationale: Call advice before AUTO_REVERSED; ambiguous -> manual review

nodes.label: Server-Side Amount Validation via Inquiry Snapshot
nodes.norm_label: server-side amount validation via inquiry snapshot
nodes.rationale: Totals taken from inquiry snapshot, never from browser-submitted numbers

nodes.label: Settlement Based on Successful Items
nodes.rationale: Include items of PARTIAL_SUCCESS parents

nodes.label: Financial Reports (Jurnal, Buku Besar, Neraca Saldo, Margin)
nodes.norm_label: financial reports (jurnal, buku besar, neraca saldo, margin)

nodes.label: Append-Only General Ledger
nodes.rationale: Triggers block UPDATE/DELETE; corrections via REVERSAL

nodes.label: net_payable = gross - admin fee
nodes.rationale: Admin fee belongs to loket

nodes.label: Sidebar navigation (Dashboard, Tagihan, Riwayat, Laporan, Pengaturan)
nodes.norm_label: sidebar navigation (dashboard, tagihan, riwayat, laporan, pengaturan)
